caption:
"Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower."

Surah Aal-i-Imraan (3:8). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #Dua #IslamicReminder #Deen #Guidance

sourcing.primary_text: Qur'an 3:8, Surah Aal-i-Imraan. Not used by any prior post (checked against all existing blankdiscussions meta.json files). Standing 8-language/10-slide format.
sourcing.arabic: Edition quran-uthmani, live call api.alquran.cloud/v1/ayah/3:8/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese,ms.basmeih,th.thai,es.cortes (HTTP 200, fetched 2026-10-17); fetched twice in the same script and diffed identical; slide text written programmatically from the raw API fields, no retyping.
sourcing.other_editions: en.sahih (Saheeh International), zh.jian (Ma Jian), ms.basmeih (Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih), th.thai (King Fahad Quran Complex), es.cortes (Julio Cortes): same call, byte-identical. ko.korean and ja.japanese: translator listed as unknown by source, slide says 'Translator not specified by source'.
sourcing.source_artifact_note: Artifact scan (double spaces, space before punctuation, leading/trailing whitespace, control chars) run on every edition; slide text byte-identical to the API. Thai edition reproduces a source-side space before '!' (Thai typographic convention in the source), kept as-is. English edition's opening quotation mark is left unclosed in the source because the quote continues in 3:9; reproduced as-is.
sourcing.verification_note: Live fetch performed this session (2026-10-17) in the same script that wrote the slide files. No wording from memory.
sourcing.compliance_check: Checked against 142 string terms in compliance-policy.json halal section across all edition text: 0 hits.

theme_note: THEME_ORDER exhausted again; new themes ash-vermilion and spruce-honey added.

hosting_verified.note: Visually spot-checked Arabic, Korean/Thai slides: no tofu or missing glyphs.
